metrics.name: stock_report_snapshot_count
metrics.targetQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.historical_stock_snapshots WHERE tenant_id = 'eeeeeeee-eeee-eeee-eeee-eeeeeeeeeeee'

metrics.name: virtual_gl_distinct_identity_count
metrics.sourceQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DocumentCode,VRow,AccCode FROM dbo.VirtualGl GROUP BY DocumentCode,VRow,AccCode) q
metrics.targetQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.historical_gl_entries WHERE tenant_id = 'eeeeeeee-eeee-eeee-eeee-eeeeeeeeeeee'

metrics.name: stock_ledger_total_count
metrics.sourceQuery: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Saledetail) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Purdetail) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.SRdetail) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.PRdetail)
metrics.targetQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.stock_ledger WHERE tenant_id = 'eeeeeeee-eeee-eeee-eeee-eeeeeeeeeeee'

metrics.name: sale_stock_ledger_count
metrics.targetQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.stock_ledger l JOIN public.business_documents d ON d.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND d.id=l.source_document_id WHERE l.tenant_id = 'eeeeeeee-eeee-eeee-eeee-eeeeeeeeeeee' AND d.legacy_source_table = 'SaleLedger' AND l.direction = 'out'

metrics.targetQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.stock_ledger l JOIN public.business_documents d ON d.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND d.id=l.source_document_id WHERE l.tenant_id = 'eeeeeeee-eeee-eeee-eeee-eeeeeeeeeeee' AND d.legacy_source_table = 'Purledger' AND l.direction = 'in'

metrics.targetQuery: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.migration_exceptions WHERE tenant_id = 'eeeeeeee-eeee-eeee-eeee-eeeeeeeeeeee' AND status = 'open') + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.migration_ambiguous_records WHERE tenant_id = 'eeeeeeee-eeee-eeee-eeee-eeeeeeeeeeee' AND status = 'open')
